style: instrumental, glossy mid-2000s tech-optimism chillout turning into cold ambient horror drone. Opens bright and sunny: shimmering glassy electric piano and crystal bell tones ringing out warm major-seventh chords, airy wide reverb, little bubbly digital chirps like water droplets on a clean desktop, a laid-back downtempo groove around 95 BPM, a hopeful start-up-screen glow, blue sky nostalgia. After a few seconds the groove stops dead: the last bell chord hangs frozen in an endless shimmering reverb tail, then a cold falling endless-descent tone slides underneath, deep sub-bass rumble, far-off muffled metallic impacts, no beat, uneasy and hollow, pure sound design. Near the end the drone keeps sinking lower and thinning out, fading to complete silence.
exclude: vocals, singing, spoken word, choir, drums after the turn, EDM drop, trap, hi-hat rolls, autotune, big pop chorus, orchestra, brass stabs, guitar solo, heavy metal, happy ending
